label: prf:qou-exists-axiom-2
title: Proof of axiom 2 (observability) for QOU existence
html:
Proof. We show \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathbf{C}}(\mathbf{1}, \mathrm{Ad}(A)) = 0. By the Peter--Weyl decomposition for compact quantum groups [woronowicz1988],

  \mathcal{O}_{q}(G)
  \;\cong\;
  \bigoplus_{\lambda \in \widehat{G}} V_{\lambda}^{*} \otimes V_{\lambda},

and the adjoint action decomposes each summand as V_{\lambda}^{*} \otimes V_{\lambda} \cong \mathrm{End}(V_{\lambda}). The invariant subspace \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathbf{C}}(\mathbf{1}, \mathrm{End}(V_{\lambda})) consists only of scalar multiples of \mathrm{id}_{V_{\lambda}}, so the only invariant morphisms \mathbf{1} \to \mathrm{Ad}(A) factor through the unit \eta \colon \mathbf{1} \to A, which is excluded by axiom~(2). Semisimplicity of G and generic q ensure no further fixed vectors appear. \square
